name: Don't DNF Denton 2024
information: ##### **This competition takes place in the afternoon. In the morning, we will have a separate Fewest Moves competition, [Texas FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasFMCChampionship2024). You can find more information on the [Texas FMC Championship 2024 tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNFDenton2024#49901-texas-fmc-championship-2024).** ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events. For a more normal competition experience, check out [Cube A Ton in Arlington 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAToninArlington2024), taking place on Sunday, December 8th, or the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list).** This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNFDenton2024#49897-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNFDenton2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
